detail: CREATE POLICY "Allow tracking updates via token" ON public.client_access_links FOR UPDATE USING (true) WITH CHECK (true); no TO clause (applies to all roles / public). Rationale in comments: allow validate_access_link (SECURITY DEFINER) to update tracking fields last_accessed_at and access_count when token matches. Extremely permissive (any role may UPDATE any row); explicitly reverted in the very next migration 20260123052614.
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow tracking updates via token" ON public.client_access_links; — removes the overly permissive UPDATE policy created in the immediately preceding migration 20260123052554.

object_name: Public can select access_links for validation
detail: CREATE POLICY "Public can select access_links for validation" ON public.client_access_links FOR SELECT USING (true); no TO clause (applies to all roles including anon). Lets anyone read every row of client_access_links so the validate_access_link RPC can find the token.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_access_link(token TEXT) RETURNS TABLE(link_id UUID, link_type TEXT, client_id UUID, site_id UUID, subsection_id UUID, is_valid BOOLEAN) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = 'public'. Behavior: calls PERFORM set_config('role', 'postgres', true) to attempt an RLS bypass, then UPDATE public.client_access_links SET last_accessed_at = now(), access_count = access_count + 1 WHERE access_token = token AND is_active = true AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()); then PERFORM set_config('role', 'anon', true) to reset, then RETURN QUERY selecting id, link_type, client_id, site_id, subsection_id and is_valid = (is_active AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())) from client_access_links WHERE access_token = token LIMIT 1. NOTE: the set_config role switch to 'postgres' is not permitted for non-superusers; this version is replaced in the very next migration 20260123052657 which removes the role switching.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_access_link(token TEXT) RETURNS TABLE(link_id UUID, link_type TEXT, client_id UUID, site_id UUID, subsection_id UUID, is_valid BOOLEAN) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = 'public'. Removes the disallowed set_config role-switching from the previous version. Behavior: SELECT id, link_type, client_id, site_id, subsection_id, access_token, is_active, expires_at INTO a record from public.client_access_links WHERE access_token = token LIMIT 1; if the record exists AND is_active = true AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()) then UPDATE public.client_access_links SET last_accessed_at = now(), access_count = access_count + 1 WHERE id = record.id (works because SECURITY DEFINER runs as owner who bypasses RLS); if the record exists, RETURN QUERY with is_valid = (is_active AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now())), otherwise return empty.
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_access_link(TEXT) TO anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.validate_access_link(TEXT) TO authenticated;

Data-consistency backfill fixing a prior status-priority bug: UPDATE subsections SET coc_status = 'Failed', is_compliant = false, updated_at = NOW() for all subsections whose coc_status = 'Approved' but whose most recent row in coc_validations (max validated_at per subsection_id) has status IN ('Fail', 'Failed', 'Incomplete'). Matters: subsections displayed as Approved/compliant despite a failing latest COC validation are flipped to Failed/non-compliant.

UPDATE subsections SET is_compliant = false, updated_at = now() WHERE id IN ('9b4f3ac9-2b95-4ab7-8e2c-b6b4ce5bd1b2' /* LV ROOM */, '9e31a990-273f-4564-8650-927935b9bacb' /* GENERATOR */, '46dfaeea-6e37-4781-9ed8-91761f38b43e' /* CENTRE MANAGEMENT */, '01b5bf41-7a9f-495e-be4b-aee8c548de96' /* SHOPRITE */, 'e6b5ba63-9a68-40da-9dc8-ccec9e5f79fd' /* SHOPRITE LIQUOR */). Five hardcoded Yarona-site subsection UUIDs that had Missing COC while requiring COC but incorrectly showed is_compliant=true.

UPDATE subsections SET is_compliant = true, updated_at = now() WHERE id = 'fb6eb96d-9f70-4e7d-984c-a52b0ddd6518' — hardcoded UUID for the DAY TO DAY subsection, which has a Pass validation with all checks passed but was incorrectly marked non-compliant.

Global backfill: UPDATE subsections SET is_compliant = false, updated_at = now() WHERE coc_status = 'Missing' AND is_coc_required = true AND is_compliant = true — flips every subsection anywhere that requires a COC, has none, yet was flagged compliant.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_coc_compliance_status() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public'. Trigger function for subsections. Behavior (only runs on INSERT, or on UPDATE when OLD.coc_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.coc_status OR OLD.is_coc_required IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.is_coc_required): (1) if NOT COALESCE(NEW.is_coc_required, false) then NEW.is_compliant := true; (2) else if the latest coc_validations row for NEW.id (max validated_at) has status IN ('Fail','Failed','Incomplete') then NEW.is_compliant := false; (3) else if NEW.coc_status IN ('Approved','Valid','Pass') then NEW.is_compliant := true; (4) otherwise (Missing, Failed, Pending, etc.) NEW.is_compliant := false. Reads coc_validations. Also COMMENT ON FUNCTION documenting this logic.
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_coc_compliance ON public.subsections; — defensive drop before (re)creation in the same migration.

CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_coc_compliance BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF coc_status, is_coc_required ON public.subsections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.sync_coc_compliance_status(); — keeps is_compliant automatically in sync with coc_status / is_coc_required changes.
ALTER TABLE public.settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_logout_enabled boolean DEFAULT false; nullable (no NOT NULL), default false.
ALTER TABLE public.settings ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS auto_logout_time time DEFAULT '02:00:00'; nullable (no NOT NULL), default 02:00:00.

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto SCHEMA extensions; — needed for crypt()/gen_salt() used by the one-off password reset below. (object_type 'extension' is outside the prescribed enum; no closer category exists.)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.temp_reset_password() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = 'public', 'extensions'. Behavior: looks up auth.users.id WHERE email = 'marries.liesie@gmail.com' (RAISE EXCEPTION 'User not found' if absent), then UPDATE auth.users SET encrypted_password = extensions.crypt('Marries@001', extensions.gen_salt('bf')) WHERE id = target_user_id. Touches auth.users directly. SECURITY NOTE: the plaintext password 'Marries@001' is committed in the migration file.

SELECT public.temp_reset_password(); — executes the function, rewriting auth.users.encrypted_password for the user with email marries.liesie@gmail.com to bcrypt('Marries@001'). One-time operational data mutation embedded in a migration.
DROP FUNCTION public.temp_reset_password(); — the temporary function is removed immediately after being invoked, in the same migration.
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_completed boolean DEFAULT false; nullable (no NOT NULL), default false.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = 'public'. Behavior: INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name) VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.email, COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', '')); then INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (NEW.id, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth.users) = 1 THEN 'Admin'::app_role ELSE 'User'::app_role END); RETURN NEW. Change vs previous version (per migration comment): new signups now get the 'User' role by default instead of 'Admin'; only the very first auth.users row gets 'Admin'. Touches profiles, user_roles, auth.users (count).

UPDATE public.profiles SET onboarding_completed = true WHERE onboarding_completed = false OR onboarding_completed IS NULL; — marks every existing user as having completed onboarding so they are not blocked by the new onboarding gate introduced with the onboarding_completed column.
CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can insert assets" ON public.site_assets FOR INSERT TO authenticated WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can update assets" ON public.site_assets FOR UPDATE TO authenticated USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can delete assets" ON public.site_assets FOR DELETE TO authenticated USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Authenticated users can view assets" ON public.site_assets FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);

UPDATE settings SET qr_base_url = 'https://wm-compliance.lovable.app' WHERE qr_base_url = 'https://watsonmattheus.com' OR qr_base_url IS NULL; — repoints the QR-code base URL from the old watsonmattheus.com domain (or unset) to the wm-compliance.lovable.app deployment; affects where generated QR codes resolve.

CREATE TABLE public.access_link_visitors: id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY; access_link_id UUID NULL REFERENCES public.client_access_links(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; first_name TEXT NOT NULL; last_name TEXT NOT NULL; email TEXT NOT NULL; phone TEXT NOT NULL; role TEXT NOT NULL; accessed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ip_address TEXT NULL; user_agent TEXT NULL. Stores visitor details and logs each access of a client access link.
ALTER TABLE public.access_link_visitors ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY "Anyone can register as visitor" ON public.access_link_visitors FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true); no TO clause (applies to all roles including anon) — allows anonymous inserts from public pages.
CREATE POLICY "Admins can view visitors" ON public.access_link_visitors FOR SELECT USING (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'Admin')); no TO clause (applies to all roles, gated by has_role).
CREATE INDEX idx_access_link_visitors_link_id ON public.access_link_visitors(access_link_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_access_link_visitors_email ON public.access_link_visitors(email);

CREATE POLICY "Public can view site assets" ON public.site_assets FOR SELECT TO anon USING (true); — opens all site_assets rows to anonymous reads for public review portals; migration comment asserts safety because site_assets contains only electrical meter metadata, no PII.
